interpretation.plain_speak: Sixteen refreshes are enough under four-write monitoring but not under two-write monitoring. The difference is how quickly the same budget is consumed: denser refreshes run out too early. Rescue depends on how long corrective capacity remains deployable, not just how many actions exist.
